# Clase Series Temporales

## Suavizado de medias móviles

```{r}
library(fpp3)
```

```{r}
aus_exports <- global_economy |>
  filter(Country == "Australia") |>
  mutate(
    `5-MA` = slider::slide_dbl(
      Exports,
      mean,
      .before = 2,
      .after = 4,
      .complete = TRUE
    )
  )
aus_exports
```

```{r}
aus_exports |>
  autoplot(Exports) +
  geom_line(aes(y = `5-MA`), colour = "#D55E00") +
  labs(y = "% del PIB", title = "Exportaciones totales de Australia")
```

```{r}
us_retail_employment_ma <- us_retail_employment |>
  mutate(
    `12-MA` = slider::slide_dbl(
      Employed,
      mean,
      .before = 5,
      .after = 6,
      .complete = TRUE
    ),
    `2x12-MA` = slider::slide_dbl(
      `12-MA`,
      mean,
      .before = 1,
      .after = 0,
      .complete = TRUE
    )
  )
us_retail_employment_ma |>
  autoplot(Employed, colour = "gray") +
  geom_line(aes(y = `2x12-MA`), colour = "#D55E00") +
  labs(
    y = "Personas (miles)",
    title = "Empleo total en el comercio minorista de EE.UU."
  )
```

$y_t-​\hat{T_t}=P_t+R_t$

​

```{r}
us_retail_employment |>
  model(
    classical_decomposition(Employed, type = "additive")
  ) |>
  components() |>
  autoplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Classical additive decomposition of total
                  US retail employment"
  )
```

```{r}
us_retail_employment_ma |>
  autoplot(Employed, colour = "gray")
```

```{r}
yt <- us_retail_employment

Pt <- us_retail_employment_ma

z <- us_retail_employment %>% mutate(yt_pt=yt$Employed-Pt$`2x12-MA`)

z %>% autoplot(yt_pt, colour = "black")

media_z <- z|>group_by(month(Month))|>mutate(media= mean(yt_pt,na.rm=TRUE))
autoplot(media_z,media)
```

```{r}
us_retail_employment_pt<- us_retail_employment|>mutate(p = Employed - us_retail_employment_ma$`2x12-MA`)

a <- us_retail_employment_pt|>group_by(month(Month))|>mutate(media= mean(p,na.rm=TRUE))
autoplot(a,media)

a
```

```{r}
#Javi
Rt <- a %>% mutate(Residuo=p-media)
autoplot(Rt,Residuo)
```

```{r}
Rt_ <- media_z %>% mutate(Residuo=yt_pt-media)
autoplot(Rt_,Residuo)
```
